title: 대법관후보추천위원회 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Chairperson and Members)
(1) The Chairperson shall represent the Recommendation Committee, preside over its meetings (hereinafter referred to as "meetings"), and exercise overall control over its affairs.
(2) Where the Chairperson is unable to perform his or her duties due to unavoidable circumstances, a member designated by the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court shall act on behalf of the Chairperson.
(3) The senior Justice of the Supreme Court referred to in Article 41-2 (3) 1 of the Act shall be the first-ranking Justice of the Supreme Court, excluding the Minister of the National Court Administration, in order of date of appointment and, where relevant, seniority by age.
